name: todo_list
description: List a todo list: every todo with its id, title, and status (open/claimed/closed). With "room": that chatroom's shared list, including creator and claimant — use it to find unclaimed work before todo_claim, and to get the todo id todo_claim/todo_close need. Without "room" (sub-agent runs only): your private run-scoped list.

room.description: Room name for the shared list, e.g. "dev". Omit it inside a sub-agent run to use your private list.
